meta.anti_hallucination_policy: Verified against primary sources only. No 2026 Q3+ unannounced products recorded. SKUs that do not exist are explicitly corrected in section 0.
primary_sources: SK hynix + SK hynix Memory Solutions America (skhms.com, news.skhynix.com)

task_corrections.task_claim: SK hynix PS1030 Gen6 2026 Q1 量产 + 7.2 GB/s 写穿
task_corrections.verified_reality: No PS1030 Gen6 SKU exists. SK hynix 2024-11 AI Summit only announced 'developing PCIe 6.0 SSD'. Real 2026 flagship is PS1101 245 TB Gen5 QLC with 321-layer V9.
Mass production 2026-02 (NOT Q3). World's first PCIe Gen6 SSD. Announced FMS 2025-07-29.
Mass production 2026-07-08 (FMS 2026 pre-show). 4nm controller. 28.4 GB/s read / 21 GB/s write.

task_corrections.task_claim: Solidigm D5-P5860 122.88 TB QLC Gen5 2025-Q4 突破
task_corrections.verified_reality: No D5-P5860 SKU. Solidigm 122.88 TB is D5-P5336 (Gen4, announced 2024-12, ramped 2025-Q1). 2025-Q3/Q4 new flagship is D7-PS1010 E1.S Gen5 (incl cold-plate liquid cooled version, 2025-09-23).
CM9 is Gen5 (BiCS8 218-layer + CBA), announced 2025-05-15. Gen6 is CM10 (BiCS10 332-layer), FMS 2026 sampling.
No PC511 SKU. YMTC QLC Gen5 SSD is PE501 (122.88 TB / X4-6080 QLC); TLC Gen5 is PE511 (X4-9070).

task_corrections.task_claim: 长江存储 X4-9070 300-layer Gen5 2026 H1
task_corrections.verified_reality: X4-9070 is Gen5 TLC but 294 total / 232 active layers (TechInsights 2025-01 dissection), not 300. Already in mass production since 2024-12, long before 2026 H1.
Accurate. Intel Optane P5800X/P5810X PCN 818679 (2024-03-22) EOL, EOIS 2025-12-31. Solidigm's own SLC is D7-P5810 (PCIe Gen4, different line, launched 2024).

Partially correct. BlueField-4 announced GTC DC 2025-10-28; 64-core Grace CPU, 800 Gb/s networking, 126B transistors; early availability 2026 with Vera Rubin platforms (NVIDIA official). Name 'Grace Blackwell 200' is inaccurate.
Correction: Micron 6600 ION 122 TB Gen5 E3.S sampling 2025-Q3, 245 TB version 2026 H1; not '60 TB AIC' (60 TB is one of multiple capacity points of 6600 ION).

task_corrections.task_claim: Samsung BM1743 128 TB QLC inference module 2026 H1 量产
task_corrections.verified_reality: 64 TB 2024-11 mass production (FMS 2024). 128 TB still in development / demo. Samsung 2025-09 roadmap lists 256 TB PCIe 6.0 (PM1763 prototype) for 2026 and 512 TB for 2027.
No CSD 6000 SKU. ScaleFlux Gen5 product is CSD5310 (FX5016 SoC, 53 GB/s RAID array). 2026-07 FMS launched Gen6 controller FC6116 (28 GB/s, 7M IOPS) and CXL controller MC600.

task_corrections.task_claim: Astera Labs 收购 Pliops 后整合 2026-Q2 客户公告
task_corrections.verified_reality: Acquisition completed 2026-02-23 (~$74M, not $70M), Israel R&D center opened; Q1 2026 results 2026-05-05 (revenue $308.4M, +93% YoY).

task_corrections.task_claim: Lightmatter Passage M1000 光子互联 + SSD 协同 2025
task_corrections.verified_reality: Passage M1000 announced 2025-03-31, 3D 4,000 mm² photonic interposer, 114 Tbps total bandwidth, 256 fibers, 448 Gbps/fiber; SC25 (2025-11) demonstrated 4 racks of production hardware; 2025-11 closed $850M funding at $4.4B valuation.

task_corrections.task_claim: Seagate Mozaic 3+ 32 TB 2025-Q4 HAMR + 36 TB 2026 H2 + 40 TB 2026-Q4
task_corrections.verified_reality: 32 TB Exos/IronWolf Pro/SkyHawk AI launched 2026-01 (NOT 2025-Q4). Mozaic 4+ (36/40/44 TB) announced 2026-03-03, two hyperscalers already qualified and in production; 40 TB is one of multiple Mozaic 4+ capacity points.

task_corrections.task_claim: WD Ultrastar DC HC590 32 TB 2025-Q3 ePMR
task_corrections.verified_reality: HC590 is 26 TB CMR (11 platters), not 32 TB. 32 TB is HC690 UltraSMR. Both shipped 2024-10-15.
Announced 2026-08-04 (MV-SF1410), PCIe Gen6 x4, NVMe 2.2, 16 NAND channels, 8 CE/channel, 3600 MT/s, sampling Q4 2026.

task_corrections.task_claim: Phison E28 Gen6 2025-Q3 量产 + E30 Gen6 PCIe 6.0 2026
task_corrections.verified_reality: Correction: E28 is Gen5 (PCIe 5.0), announced CES 2025-01, retail 2025-Q3. Phison's real Gen6 controller is PS5303-X3 (announced Computex 2026-06, samples 2026-12, mass production mid-2027). No 'Phison E30' product.

task_corrections.task_claim: Hynix in-house 主控 Ocean Gen5 2025-Q4
task_corrections.verified_reality: Inaccurate name. SK hynix in-house controller is called 'Alistar' (revealed 2024-03 Tom's Hardware), used in Platinum P51 Gen5 SSD with 238-layer TLC. Subsequent in-house: PS1101 (321-layer QLC, 2025-2026).
Correction: SM8388 is Gen5 (16 NAND channels, 2400 MT/s, max 128 TB), demonstrated Computex 2026-06. SMI's Gen6 is SM8466 (28 GB/s, 7M IOPS, 512 TB), same Computex.
No MAP1808 model. Maxio Gen5 products are MAP1806 (8-channel, 2025-04 review, 2025 mass production), MAP1802 (4-channel DRAMless, end of 2025), enterprise MAP1803 (production testing 2026 H1).

Correction: STAR2000 is Gen4 (12 nm, Arm A55, 2022-12 tape-out, 2023 mass production). Gen5 models are STAR1500 (PCIe 5.0, RISC-V 8-core) and STAR1516 (16-channel enterprise PCIe 5.0), announced FMS 2023-08, won 2024-11 China Chip Award. STAR6000 has no public confirmation.

Correction: Yingren IG5636 (Rainier) is Gen4 (2020 mass production). Gen5 models are YR S900 (2023-09 first mass-produced Gen5 enterprise, RISC-V) and Tacoma IG5669 (announced 2022-05, 16/18 NAND channels). IG5660 not listed on official product page. 2025-06 launched Dongting-N3 PCIe 5.0 SSD; 2025-08 Dongting-N3X (PCIe 5.0 + KIOXIA XL-FLASH).

task_corrections.task_claim: NVIDIA Magnum IO GDS v1.1 2025-09 + v1.2 2026 H1
task_corrections.verified_reality: Correction: GDS v1.1 was 2022-06 (NOT 2025-09). NVIDIA GDS has been merged into CUDA distribution. Actual 2025 versions: v1.13/v1.14 (RHEL 8.10/9.4/UB 24.04 support). Latest v1.18 (2026-07-02). v1.11.x is 2024 release.
Mostly accurate. Supplementation: v26.01 LTS (2026-01-28) includes NVMe 2.0 target + NVMe target RDMA interrupt support; v26.05 (2026-05-28) includes NVMe KV support.
Accurate. Intel 2024-12-05 announced SPDK 2025 transition to LF; v25.05 (2025-05-29) was first LF release.

Correction: RocksDB 10.0.0 actually released 2025-02-21, 10.5.0 doesn't exist (10.4/10.5 numbers not used); 10.6.0 = 2025-08-22 (MultiScan intro); 10.7.0 = 2025-09-24; 10.10.1 = 2026-02-02; 11.0.0 = 2026-02-23 (wide-column blob + FIFO + interpolation search); 11.7.0 = 2026-07-16.

key_trends_2025_2026_h2: PCIe Gen6 enterprise SSD three-way race (2026): Micron 9650 (2026-02 mass production, world's first), Samsung PM1763 (2026-07-08 mass production, 4nm controller), Kioxia CM10 (2026-07-30 announced, sampling). Phison PS5303-X3 and SMI SM8466 controllers announced Computex 2026-06, SSD mass production 2027 mid. Marvell Bravera SC6 (MV-SF1410) controller announced 2026-08-04, sampling Q4 2026.

QLC capacity flagship enters 245 TB era: Solidigm D5-P5336 122 TB (2025-Q1 ramp), Kioxia LC9 122 TB (2025-Q1 GTC), Micron 6600 ION 122 TB (2025-Q3 sampling) → 245 TB (2026 H1), SK hynix PS1101 245 TB QLC (2025-2026, 321-layer V9), Samsung BM1743 64 TB mass produced 2024-11, 128 TB in dev; 256 TB PCIe Gen6 prototype shown FMS 2025 with mass production target 2026; 512 TB roadmap 2027.

HAMR HDD mass production (2026): Seagate Mozaic 3+ 32 TB launched 2026-01 across three product lines (Exos $729, IronWolf Pro $1,160, SkyHawk AI $699); Seagate Mozaic 4+ 36-44 TB announced 2026-03-03, two hyperscalers qualified and in production. WD Ultrastar DC HC590 (26 TB CMR) + HC690 (32 TB UltraSMR) shipped 2024-10.

AI software stack matured (2025-2026): NVIDIA BlueField-4 (announced 2025-10, available 2026 with Vera Rubin, 64-core Grace + 800 Gb/s + Inference Context Memory Storage Platform). Astera Labs + Pliops: acquisition closed 2026-02 ($74M); Q1 2026 revenue $308M (+93% YoY); Scorpio X-Series shipping. Lightmatter Passage M1000 (announced 2025-03, 114 Tbps, SC25 production hardware demo, $4.4B valuation). ScaleFlux CSD5310 (Gen5) + FC6116 (Gen6 controller, 2026-07 FMS) + Caliptra 2.0 quantum security.

Chinese SSD controllers accelerated (2025-2026): Maxio 2026 H1 revenue +39% YoY, net profit +821% YoY; MAP1803 enterprise Gen5 in production testing; Gen6/Gen7 controllers in R&D. Starblaze STAR1500/STAR1516 (Gen5 RISC-V) shipping; STAR2000E Gen4 in industrial deployment. Yingren YR S900 (Gen5 RISC-V) shipping; 2025 SATA eSSD China #2; 2026-07 STAR Market IPO inquiry; Dongting-N3/N3X/N3Q full coverage.

SPDK LF transfer complete (2025-2026): v25.05 (2025-05) first LF release; v25.09 (2025-09) NVMe 1.4 + NSSR; v26.01 LTS (2026-01) NVMe 2.0 target + BlueField-3 performance report; v26.05 (2026-05) NVMe KV support (aligns with KVSSD roadmap).
